items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Ella was the head of the band and Taft was like the overseer of the band. I think from then on, we played several places around

ctx.x: How long did you stay with them?

I don't remember exactly. Not quite a year. I have to just get my thoughts together. We went down there and we did our thing to pay tribute. It was a great, big thing, because Chick was from Baltimore. It was a big stadium, and all the acts were there. Oh, everybody came over to play. Billie Holiday. The City of Baltimore gave their respect to Chick Webb, who happens to be one of their citizens.

So we did that, we were there, and we came back to the Savoy. Like, Ella was the head of the band and Taft was like the overseer of the band. I think from then on, we played several places around; I just can't remember now.
